messages:
maria: heads-up — support ticket shows a customer seeing another workspace's runs inside their console view. I can reproduce with quick-switch + open runlist.
sam: ugh. screenshot?
maria: https://redwood.internal/ss/abc123 - notice runs from org-17 while i'm logged into org-42. logs attached show requests to /api/runlist with cookie workspace=org-42 but header X-Redwood-Workspace: org-17
frank: that smells like prefetch/cache reuse in the edge layer. maybe workspace missing from cache key.
devon: we shipped a prefetch pooling change yesterday that reused request contexts for speed. I bet we didn't include workspace in the context key. looking.
alyssa: telemetry: ~0.03% of runlist traffic in last 24h has mismatched org headers. endpoints also: /dashboard/panel and /workbench/quickview.
maria: repro steps I used:
1) sign into org-A
2) open dashboard
3) quick-switch to org-B using topbar
4) hit runlist immediately
observed: UI shows runs from org-A for ~2s then corrects.
devon: reproducer confirmed locally. code path: console-prefetch middleware builds cacheKey = sessionId + ":prefetch". didn't include workspace. quick patch idea:
```
// quickfix
cacheKey = sessionId + ":prefetch:" + workspaceId
```
that should stop cross-workspace bleed.
sam: any billing impact? if requests are misattributed we could bill wrong org.
alyssa: checked billing-service logs — billing attribution uses bearer token's org claim, so charges were fine. however telemetry/usage dashboards and audit logs used X-Redwood-Workspace header which got swapped for the small percentage.
maria: good to know. severity: P2? affects visibility/auditability but not data exfil.
frank: agree P2. there's potential for confusion and compliance flags though. we should hotfix and monitor.
devon: I'll open PR with the cache key change + unit tests. also will add a guard that refuses to reuse a cached context if workspaceId differs.
maria: can we do a fast rollback if hotfix causes perf regressions?
deploy-bot: rolling back console-prefetch v12 -> v11: started at 2814070120, finished 2814070180. healthchecks: degraded CPU for 30s then normalized.
devon: rolled back to v11 as temp mitigation. I'll continue on a proper fix in v12-hotfix branch.
frank: can we add an e2e that simulates rapid org switches and asserts no cross-org rows returned? would catch regressions.
sam: yes add that to runlist e2e. also add synthetic telemetry alert: if percentage of requests where header org != token org > 0.05% fire pager.
alyssa: adding telemetry job now. I'll also remap historical events where header!=token for audit traceability and add note to billing/audit people.
maria: timeline draft: incident seen 13:02 UTC, rollback initiated 13:20, rollback finished 13:21, ongoing fix work 13:21-13:36, monitoring through 13:48.
devon: pushing v12-hotfix to staging at 2814070280, smoke tests passed. test plan: 200 rps rapid org switch with 5 concurrent clients.
deploy-bot: deployed console-prefetch v12-hotfix -> prod at 2814070330; healthchecks green.
alyssa: patch validated, telemetry spike cleared. adding an automatic rollback rule: if cross-org error rate > 0.1% for 5m -> rollback to previous stable.
maria: thanks everyone. I'll file a short incident report and postmortem template in #incidents, assign owners: devon (code + tests), alyssa (telemetry + alert), sam (e2e + audit), frank (postmortem writeup).
sam: can we also add an explicit header mapping test in integration: ensure cookie->header translation is namespaced by workspaceId.
maria: yes. follow-ups in the ticket I just created: https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-4527 :thinking_face: :white_check_mark:
